title: MULTIVOX: A Benchmark for Evaluating Voice Assistants for Multimodal Interactions
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating paralinguistic and visual grounding capabilities of multimodal voice assistants. It includes an analysis of gender and age bias in model responses, but it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics. Mentions of ethics are confined to data collection procedures (e.g., using TTS for children's voices) and a brief risks section.
